title: Only 90s Kids Get This: Being into 90s kid problem costs you your last working brain cell
caption:
Being into 90s kid problem costs you your last working brain cell

Inducted unanimously, no notes:
1️⃣ The Dial-Up Opera — The internet sang its war song for 45 seconds, then one page arrived, in pieces, like a ransom note.
2️⃣ The Blowing Ritual — Cartridges needed human breath to function. Science never explained it. We all did it anyway, twice.
3️⃣ The Away Message Poem — Your entire personality fit in 3 lines of emo lyrics and a song title. That was your brand. That was you.
4️⃣ The Be Kind Rewind — Renting a movie came with a moral duty. Rewinding was a personality test most of us failed loudly.
